Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
When you first play Brujah Debate, must you tap a Brujah before you
exit your Master phase? TIV.

"Put this card in play. Each Methuselah with a ready Brujah must tap
one of the highest capacity Brujah he or she controls during his or
her master phase. Each Brujah gets +1 strength and an optional
maneuver each combat.This card may be burned by any minion who is not
Ventrue as a (D) action."

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Jeff Kuta <jeff...@gmail.com> wrote:
> When you first play Brujah Debate, must you tap a Brujah before you
> exit your Master phase? TIV.

Yes. You must resolve all effects when a card enters play.

Similarly, you must burn pool equal to the number of vampires you
have in torpor immediately after you play Dragonbound.
